name: omni-investigation-history-and-mttr-reporter
description: Summarizes CloudWatch Omni investigation history and DevOps Agent investigations into a program-level reliability view: recurring-root-cause clusters, time-to-detect and time-to-recover (MTTR) trends, and repeat-offender services and dependencies across teams and Spaces. Omni captures full investigation history automatically and DevOps Agent participates in every session. Read-only and recommend-only; relies on CloudWatch-native reads plus surfaced Omni context (no assumed Omni API) and recommends a CloudWatch/Omni MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 09:00 UTC
